'''Shivanek''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was killed by an elite Republic strike team.

==Biography==
Captain Shivanek was a Sith captain who had been stationed at the Sith base on [[Taral V]] during the Cold War. He, along with his pet beast [[Ripper (pet)|Ripper]], were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an elite four man strike team that had been [[Battle of Taral V|sent]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]] to recover a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] computer that was needed in order to rescue a [[Revan/Legends|Jedi Master]] being held prisoner by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|The Maelstrom]].<ref name="TaralV" /> He had red markings on his armor, showing his allegiance to the Sith Empire.
